findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice long questions for Unit 14 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 24 questions numbered 1-24; by section: 14.1.5 1, 14.1.7 1, 14.1.9 1, 14.2.3 1, 14.2.4 1, 14.2.5 1, 14.2.7 2, 14.2.8 2, 14.3.5 1, 14.3.6 2, 14.3.7 3, 14.4.2 2, 14.4.3 1, 14.4.4 1, 14.4.5 3, 14.4.6 1.

24 five-mark questions: the unit's derivations (distributive property, direction cosines result, projection formula, dot product in components, determinant formula for u x v, volume of parallelepiped and tetrahedron, determinant formula for the scalar triple product) and its main problem types (magnitudes and unit vectors, right triangle, angle, work done, cross products, areas, moments and torque, volumes, coplanarity) with new data. Book corrections followed (AB = OB - OA, u x v = -(v x u), 1/6 for the tetrahedron, c2 in the determinant). Every step was checked by computation (sympy, check14.py).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
